Trust the garage you ride to

Verified genuine mechanics

Mechanics who buy genuine spares from Bike Pharma are verified automatically. The system reads each garage's purchase history and issues the ID like BPM-0231 and the QR code on its own. There is nothing to apply for or submit; customers scan the code to know the mechanic fits genuine parts, not copies.
